hero.title: Your laboratory for freedom

whoWeAre.title: A group devoted to those who want to live without borders
whoWeAre.body: Hofshilab Group brings together companies and specialists in international mobility, wealth structuring and global citizenship. We turn bureaucracy into strategy so you can build the life you want.

freedom.title: We help free people become citizens of the world
freedom.intro: We bring together services, products and knowledge so you can take the next step of your international life with confidence. We help you:
items: Move residency, emigrate or live as a perpetual traveler
Open companies and accounts in the best countries for business
Reduce bureaucracy, optimize taxes and protect your wealth legally
Obtain second citizenships and passports for your plan B
Adopt the digital nomad lifestyle with comfort and savings
Grow your wealth with international investments

flagTheory.title: Plant your flags around the world
flagTheory.intro: The classic strategy of international freedom: place each area of your life in the best country for it — and stop depending on a single place.
